title: Campfire Night Fellowship
excerpt: Join us for an unforgettable evening around the campfire filled with worship, testimonies, games, and meaningful connections under the stars.
author: Pr Isaac Ling
content:
There’s something special about gathering around a campfire. The warmth, the laughter, and the shared stories create moments that stay in our hearts forever. Our Campfire Night Fellowship is more than just an event — it’s an opportunity to strengthen friendships, grow in faith, and enjoy God’s creation together.

A Night to Remember

The evening will be filled with acoustic worship, inspiring testimonies, fun games, marshmallow roasting, and heartfelt conversations under the stars. Whether you’re coming with friends or meeting new people for the first time, everyone is welcome around the fire.

"Some of the best memories are made sitting around a campfire with people who inspire you."

Bring your jackets, your favorite snacks, and an open heart as we spend time together building community and creating lasting memories. Let’s gather around the fire and celebrate friendship, faith, and fellowship.

title: Captured Moments Together
excerpt: A special collection of group photos capturing laughter, friendship, and unforgettable memories shared together as a community.
author: Church Administration
content:
Every group photo tells a story of friendship, unity, and shared experiences. These moments captured together remind us of the joy found in community and the memories created through every gathering, event, and celebration.

Memories That Last

From candid smiles to joyful laughter, each photo reflects the bonds we continue to build as a family. Whether it’s during fellowship nights, outdoor activities, or special celebrations, these snapshots preserve moments we will cherish for years to come.

"Great moments are even better when shared together."

As we look back at these group photos, we celebrate not just the events themselves, but the people who made them meaningful. Here’s to more laughter, stronger friendships, and many more memories together.
